verdict.rationale: Fireworks publishes an OpenAPI 3.1 spec, the "Gateway REST API" at version 5.10.0, with /v1/-prefixed endpoints, which shows its API surface is versioned. Nothing in the pack documents a deprecation policy, sunset timelines or a version-support commitment, so only half the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy, deprecation notice/sunset timelines, a version-support guarantee or changelog, and independent corroboration.
